attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Veterinary Medicine (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE credits from an approved sponsor
rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduates of an accredited veterinary school within one year of the first renewal are exempt for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; 60 days to submit documentation; do not send certificates with the renewal.
rules.notes: Applies to active-status veterinarians. All licenses renew by June 30 of even-numbered years. No online limit stated on the Board page.
